text:
Maya: Hi team — kicking off the Empower IAC Bridge Playbook handoff to Cloud Partner X. Goal: publish a Terraform starter kit + reference architecture + CI smoke tests by Apr 12. Draft link: https://redwood.internal/empower-iac
Dan: thanks — quick clarifying q: infra targets? arm64/x86 + GKE/EKS/AzureAKS?
Maya: initial scope = AWS (EKS) + GCP (GKE). Graviton/Arm planned for v2. Keep modules minimal: vpc, cluster, node_pool, lb, kms.
Sarah: I'll own docs + repo layout. Will add README template + onboarding checklist. ETA Apr 5.
Leo: I'll own TF modules review and testing harness. Suggest standard outputs: cluster_id, node_pool_ids, kubeconfig_path.
Nina: legal asked for a simple data-flow diagram and a compliance call. I'll collect questions and share.
Dan: quick module usage snippet for reference (will include in README):
```
module "cluster" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-iac/empower-cluster.git//modules/eks"
  cluster_name = "empower-${var.partner_short}"
  node_count = var.node_count
}
```
Leo: I'll add `validation/plan.yml` CI: `terraform init && terraform plan -var-file=ci.tfvars` and a quick smoke apply in a sandbox project. PR incoming by Apr 8.
PartnerBot: Reminder: partner-content-checklist created: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/PART-1234 (labels: partner, iaac, marketplace)
Maya: Action items roundup:
 - Sarah: README + onboarding guide (due Apr 5)
 - Leo: module tests + CI (due Apr 8)
 - Dan: infra reference arch doc + diagram (due Apr 6)
 - Nina: partner questionnaire & compliance checklist (due Apr 4)
 - Marcus: solution patterns + customer scenario examples (due Apr 9)
Maya: We also need a volunteer for publishing the marketplace tile / metadata.
Sarah: I can draft the marketplace metadata (short blurb + screenshots).
Leo: thanks — can we add a short "hardware compatibility" subsection (Ampere/Graviton notes)? Partner asked about runtime perf.
Dan: yes — I'll add a compatibility appendix with recommended instance families and a quick perf note.
Marcus: will draft 2 customer scenarios: "low-latency inference" and "cost-optimized batch inference" that map to config examples.
Nina: scheduled kickoff call Thu 10am PT; calendar invite sent.
Maya: I'll open the repo `github.com/redwood/empower-iac-bridge` and push initial skeleton + issue tracker.
Maya: tagging @solutions to loop Marcus in the repo and doc reviews.
Marcus: joining — will review module outputs and provide example app wiring.
Maya: minor nit: keep Terraform module outputs stable across minor versions to avoid breaking partner automation.
Leo: noted. We'll add a semver policy doc and changelog template.
Dan: also propose a small `examples/` dir with a minimal deploy, and a `deploy.sh` helper for partner quickstarts.
Sarah: I'll include screenshots + a short video snippet for the marketplace listing (30s).
PartnerBot: Checklist status: README (open), CI (open), examples (open), marketplace metadata (open), diagram (open).
Maya: Thanks all. Next sync after PRs merge. :rocket:
